page.overview:
Who is Caliondo?

Caliondo was the son of Eärendur, the second son of Tar-Amandil, the third King of Númenor.

Caliondo was born to Eärendur and his unnamed wife in an unknown place in Númenor. Caliondo had one child, a son named Malantur, the King's presumptive heir. Nothing else is known about his life.
